themes_detail.label: Asbestos Spike in Buildings
themes_detail.summary: Community District 208 received 3 asbestos-related complaints THIS WEEK, a 700% spike compared to the 8-week average of 0.4 complaints per week, suggesting either a disclosure event, renovation discovery, or acute exposure concern in an aging housing stock.
evidence: 3 asbestos complaints filed THIS WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (700% increase, z-score: 5.42)
Riverdale/Fieldston has 332 active DOB building permits in last 90 days (200 alterations), creating potential for asbestos disturbance during renovation work
Community board has submitted repeated budget requests for building facility upgrades, indicating aging infrastructure
reporting_angles: Track which buildings triggered complaints and whether renovations/construction preceded them
Investigate whether DOB is adequately inspecting for asbestos during the 200+ active alteration projects
Interview residents about awareness of asbestos risks in aging Riverdale/Fieldston housing stock

themes_detail.label: Street Sign Hazards Emerge
themes_detail.summary: Dangling street sign complaints jumped to 7 THIS WEEK from a baseline of 1.1 per week (522% spike), suggesting deteriorating street infrastructure or maintenance gaps in what is likely a heavily tree-lined neighborhood.
evidence: 7 dangling street sign complaints filed THIS WEEK vs. 1.1 weekly baseline (522% increase, z-score: 4.05)
Street condition complaints total 868 over 90 days, indicating broader pavement and infrastructure deterioration
Community board has repeatedly requested traffic and pedestrian safety improvements, including from DOT
reporting_angles: Map the 7 dangling sign locations to identify whether a specific area or corridor is being neglected
File FOIL request to DOT for street sign inspection/replacement schedule—has funding been cut?
Check whether dangling signs pose pedestrian or traffic hazards in high-foot-traffic areas

themes_detail.label: Park Rule Violations Spike Dramatically
themes_detail.summary: Park rule violation complaints reached 7 LAST WEEK, a 2700% spike from the 8-week average of 0.2 per week, suggesting either a specific event, new activity pattern, or enforcement change at a key Riverdale park.
evidence: 7 park rule violation complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.2 weekly average (2700% increase, z-score: 15.59)
Concurrent spike in park-related noise (3 complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.4 baseline, 700% increase) and encampments (4 complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.4 baseline, 967% increase)
Community board has repeatedly requested park renovations and new maintenance equipment, suggesting existing parks may be underfunded
reporting_angles: Identify which Riverdale parks are generating complaints—Van Cortlandt? Palisade? Spuyten Duyvil Shorefront?
Interview Parks Department on whether new enforcement, seasonal changes, or homeless encampments are driving violations
Canvass park users about what rule violations they're witnessing and whether parks feel unsafe or poorly maintained

themes_detail.label: Street Noise Crisis Escalates
themes_detail.summary: Street and sidewalk noise complaints surged to 126 LAST WEEK, a 740% spike from the 15.0 weekly average, indicating a major new source of disruption—potentially construction, street vending, or transportation-related activity.
evidence: 126 street/sidewalk noise complaints LAST WEEK vs. 15.0 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (740% increase, z-score: 10.54)
Residential noise complaints remain chronically high at 1,635 over 90 days (third-largest complaint category)
Community board has requested traffic calming and pedestrian safety improvements from DOT, suggesting chronic noise/traffic pressure
reporting_angles: Correlate the noise spike with active construction permits (332 filed, including 200 alterations) to identify whether renovation sites are the source
Interview affected residents on specific streets to identify the noise source—construction, bars, street vendors, or traffic
Request DOT data on recent changes to street use, deliveries, or commercial activity permits

themes_detail.label: Street Sweeping Deterioration
themes_detail.summary: Street sweeping complaints jumped to 8 LAST WEEK from a 1.0 weekly baseline (700% spike), paired with 473 unsanitary condition complaints over 90 days, signaling a potential sanitation service gap or resource shortage.
evidence: 8 street sweeping complaints LAST WEEK vs. 1.0 weekly baseline (700% increase, z-score: 5.29)
473 unsanitary condition complaints over 90 days, indicating chronic sanitation concerns
Illegal parking complaints total 3,169 over 90 days—may be blocking street sweeping access in narrow Riverdale/Fieldston streets
reporting_angles: Interview DSNY about whether Riverdale/Fieldston collection routes have been reduced or rerouted
Photograph affected streets to document litter accumulation and maintenance gaps
Investigate whether the 3,169 illegal parking complaints are preventing adequate street cleaning
